questions.question: Through the prophet Jeremiah, God said the people of Jerusalem refuse to return to Him. What did He say they cling to?
Through the prophet Jeremiah, God said His people know His requirements as well as the stork knows her seasons. True or false?
In Jeremiah's day, the people lamented that a sound from Dan made the whole land quake. What was the sound?
Through the prophet Jeremiah, God warned He would send vipers among His people. What did He say about them?

answers.text: They cannot be charmed and will bite
They will stay out in the desert
They will only bite the leaders
